cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Tell the committee we're considering the festival bid. Just the announcement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Once they've reserved the date, we'll have something worth protecting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I prefer starting with the consequence that encourages us.
